id.description: A unique UUID identifying this calendar

name.description: A user-provided name used to label this calendar

startDate.description: The first effective date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of this calendar

endDate.description: The first effective date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of this calendar

assignments.description: A list of all service points that this calendar is assigned to

normalHours.description: A list of objects describing when the calendar is normally open

exceptions.description: A list of objects describing exceptions to the normal hours

exceptionRange.description: An exception to a calendar, consisting of a set of openings (or none if a closure)

calendarId.description: The UUID of the calendar which this exception is for

name.description: A user-provided label for this exception

startDate.description: The first effective date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of this exception range

endDate.description: The first effective date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of this exception range

exceptionalOpening.description: An opening as part of an exception

exceptionId.description: The UUID of the exception which this opening is for

startDate.description: The first effective date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of this opening

startTime.description: The first opening time (inclusive) of this opening

endDate.description: The first effective date (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of this opening

endTime.description: The last open time (inclusive) of this opening

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the calendar. This is provided by the server on a best-effort basis; no fields are guaranteed to be present. Metadata is provided from Okapi; any metadata sent directly from the client will be ignored.

normalHours.description: A range of hours when a calendar is open

calendarId.description: The UUID of the calendar which these hours are for

startDay.description: The first weekday (inclusive) of this range

startTime.description: The time when this opening starts, inclusive

endDay.description: The last weekday (inclusive) of this range

endTime.description: The last minute of this opening, inclusive (11:59 if it should be open at 11:59 and closed at 12:00)

servicePointId.description: A UUID uniquely identifying a service point

weekday.description: A day of the week.  Either SUNDAY, MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, or SATURDAY
